name: Domino

abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Perfect Block: Bloklarken gelen tüm hasarı sıfıra indirir.
abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Critical Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Taunt: Saldırı gücünü %40 azaltır ve özel saldırı etkinleştirme şansını %70 artırır.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Yetenek doğruluğu azaltma immünitesi olanlar en iyisi. Şansa dayalı yetenekler kullanan şampiyon riskli. Tech şampiyon kullan, güç barı dolarken kaçışa dikkat et.
signatureAbility:
Critical Failure
Opponents take up to [1,090.2 - 6,541.2] Energy Damage over 1.5 second(s) whenever their abilities fail to trigger. Damage scales with Base Attack only. Potency decreases temporarily for consecutive triggers.

abilitySections.title: Probability Field Passive
content: At the start of the fight, opponents lose [305.56] Critical Rating and Domino gains the same amount.
Opponents lose 15% Ability Accuracy. This reduction has no effect against abilities that trigger at the start of a fight.
Whenever one of Domino's abilities fails to trigger, she gains +10% Ability Accuracy for 8 seconds.
Domino's Bleed abilities tend to strike vital points and have a chance to benefit from her Critical Damage bonuses equal to her Critical Chance.

Opponents' Bleed Debuffs tend to graze and have a 50% chance to be Passively Purified after only 1 second(s). Whenever a Bleed is Purified this way, Domino is inspired and gains 10% of her maximum Power instantly.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: Domino uses her pistol for her first Light hit, her second Medium hit, and her final Heavy hit. These hits do not make contact with opponents.
Benefit from up to +[4,360.8] Attack Rating selected at random.
Benefit from up to +[1,833.33] Critical Damage selected at random.
A Critical Hit with a maximum roll in both Attack and Critical Damage Ratings results in a Perfect Critical Hit that inflicts Stun for 1 to 3 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: If the opponent is Stunned, Attack Rating is increased by +[10,902] for this attack.

abilitySections.title: Blocking
content: Benefit from up to +[1,833.33] Block Proficiency selected at random.
A Well-Timed Block with a high roll in Block Proficiency results in a Perfect Block, reducing incoming attack damage to zero and granting 10% maximum Power instantly.
While Lucky, a Block with a maximum roll in Block Proficiency also results in a Perfect Block and bonus Power.

abilitySections.title: When Filling a Bar of Power
content: 30% chance for Domino to gain a Lucky Passive. 25% of Domino's current Combo Meter count is added to this chance.
30% chance for opponents to suffer an Unlucky Passive. 25% of the opponents' current Combo Meter count is added to this chance.
Lucky and Unlucky effects last for a random duration between 1 and 5 seconds plus 1.5 additional second(s) for each full Bar of Power at the time of activation.
Skill Champions are always Unlucky.
Tech Champions are never Unlucky.

abilitySections.title: Lucky Passive
content: +[375] Critical Rating.
+[523.81] Critical Damage Rating.
+15% Ability Accuracy.
+[485.29] Block Proficiency.
10% chance to Evade attacks.
Stun expires 35% faster.
Domino is more likely to earn a higher roll when selecting Attack Rating, Critical Damage Rating, and Block Proficiency bonuses at random.

abilitySections.title: Unlucky Passive
content: -[375] Critical Rating.
-[379.31] Critical Damage Rating.
-[305.56] Critical Resistance.
-35% Ability Accuracy.
-[485.29] Block Proficiency.
100% chance for Evade or the Dexterity Mastery to fail.
Bleed abilities deal 50% less damage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each hit has 25% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [11,992.2] Direct Damage over 7 seconds.
If Domino is Lucky, this attack refreshes all Stun and Bleed effects on the opponent.
If the opponent is Unlucky, this attack has +[2,180.4] Attack Rating for each second that passed since the last time Domino hit with a Special Attack this fight.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each hit has 25% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [26,164.8] Direct Damage over 7 seconds. This Bleed does not benefit from the Lucky bonus below.
If Domino is Lucky, this attack has +[10,902] Attack Rating if Domino suffered from Bleed at least once this fight.
If the opponent is Unlucky, they're inflicted with a Taunt passive by this flashy attack, reducing their Attack by 20% until they are no longer Unlucky.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 74% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [26,164.8] Direct Damage over 7 seconds.
If Domino is Lucky, this attack has +[327.06] Attack Rating for every Critical Hit that occured this fight by either Domino or her opponent. (Max: 100 Critical Hits)
If the opponent is Unlucky, this attack inflicts Armor Break, removing one Armor Up and reducing Armor by [775.64] for 4 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Critical Failure
content: Opponents take up to [1,090.2 - 6,541.2] Energy Damage over 1.5 second(s) whenever their abilities fail to trigger. Damage scales with Base Attack only. Potency decreases temporarily for consecutive triggers.
